_note: Explicit, auditable mapping from a claim's recorded `topic` to patient-question IDs, used ONLY for claims that carry no question mapping of their own (production prototype-v1 and the baseline register). It is a coarse topic proxy, not a clinical judgement; every use is tagged mapping_basis=topic_rule. Candidate claims keep their own source-provided mappedPatientQuestionIds. Topics not listed (core_condition_knowledge, null) are deliberately left unmapped.
